title: Boundary-lifting maps of quasicategories are coherent equivalences
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, quasicategories, internal functor simplicial sets, equivalence edges and coherent functor equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in a fixed sufficiently large universe. Let $p:X\to Y$ be a simplicial map between quasicategories. Suppose that for every $n\geq0$ every commutative square with left map $\partial\Delta^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ and right map $p$ admits a diagonal filler, where $\partial\Delta^n$ is the union of the proper faces and $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$. Then there exist a simplicial map $s:Y\to X$ and a coherent natural equivalence $\eta:\mathrm{id}_X\simeq sp$ in $\operatorname{Fun}(X,X)$ such that $ps=\mathrm{id}_Y$ and $p\eta$ is the degenerate transformation of $p$. In particular the specified map $p$ is a coherent functor equivalence. This includes empty quasicategories; no Kan condition on $X$ or $Y$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08NS, label lemma-trivial-kan-homotopy (section and cylinder homotopy), using Tag 08NM, label lemma-trivial-kan. The coherent-equivalence assertion is an agent expansion for quasicategories, not an assertion of the Stacks lemma; pointwise equivalences are as in lem-cbc-enhanced-functor-cone-calculus.
